findings.priorDefect: The IO lane returned Pair<Record,FileData> to a deferred main callback, so two prepared screens could retain original bytes while the next provider read started.
findings.reviewedCorrection: The original file remains local to one read→prepare→upload IO job. The posted Transfer contains only record/recovery metadata or an Exception. activeFile was removed. The metadata callback starts registration separately. Unknown upload preserves the prepared descriptor/key/context for explicit exact retry.
findings.proofBoundary: Independent source/delta review plus inspection of author actual Robolectric RED/GREEN evidence; no independent rerun of the Android UI suite.

reviewedOtherBoundaries: Fresh /me, canonical media.register catalog, allowed site/task/company context at each typed step
Stable distinct upload/register keys; immutable hash/metadata; known uploadId no-reupload
Full authority + exact client/session generation; metadata-only encrypted descriptors and nativeMedia command-envelope marker; generic retry bypass denied
Known registration ACK retained across checkpoint/cleanup failure; restored REGISTERED uses local cleanup only
Own-origin copy=client download; percent-encoded opaque ID, current entity/version/company, no redirects, MIME/cumulative limits, ticket checks while writing explicit system copy
Six locale XML catalogs,347 keys each, unique/nonempty values and positional-placeholder parity
